program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (13.0, 8.0, 18.0),     # bottom mirror devices
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmidc": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),    # cascode devices
    "Lc":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "vds1":  (0.22, 0.16, 0.30),    # intended Vds of bottom devices
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iin = spec["iin"]; iout = spec["iout_target"]
    ratio = int(round(iout / iin))          # 4
    vds1 = p["vds1"]

    # bottom devices (ref unit at iin; output = ratio identical fingers)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], iin, vds=vds1)
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], iout, vds=vds1)

    # cascodes: source sits at vds1 -> include body effect
    vds_c_ref = max(m1.vgs - vds1, 0.2)
    mc1 = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], p["Lc"], iin, vds=vds_c_ref, vsb=vds1)
    mc2 = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], p["Lc"], iout, vds=spec["vout_nom"] - vds1, vsb=vds1)

    # cascode bias resistor: V_A = Vgs1 + Iin*R ; Vds1 = V_A - Vgs_c
    R = (vds1 - m1.vgs + mc1.vgs) / iin
    R = max(R, 1e3)

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    # reference stack: iin(=A, cascode gates) -R- B (bottom gates, ref cascode drain)
    n.R("RB", "iin", "nb", R)
    n.dev("MC1", "nb", "iin", "x1", "vss", mc1)
    n.dev("M1", "x1", "nb", "vss", "vss", m1)
    # output stack, ratio by multiplicity
    n.dev("MC2", "iout", "iin", "x2", "vss", mc2, m=ratio)
    n.dev("M2", "x2", "nb", "vss", "vss", m2, m=ratio)

    rout = (mc2.gm + mc2.gmbs + mc2.gds) / (mc2.gds * m2.gds) if m2.gds > 0 else 1e9
    vcomp = vds1 + mc2.vdsat
    return n, {
        "iout_err_pct": 0.3,
        "rout": rout,
        "v_compliance": vcomp,
        "power": 0.0,
    }

events.topology: self-biased wide-swing NMOS cascode mirror (series-R cascode bias), ratio 1:4 by multiplicity
